decisions.notes: Individually inspected all twelve views: detailed wood-planked hull, high stern gallery, bowsprit, rigging and weathered sails. Distinct larger, higher-stern design compared with the existing medium merchant ship.
limitations: Uses 1K texture maps, not the upstream 4K version.
Static shipped glTF: no animation clips or armature; sail and rigging are fixed.
No interior access or onboard controls were verified.
Khronos validator reports three warnings; see the packaged report.

decisions.notes: Inspected all twelve views. The textured exterior looks good, but is near indistinguishable from the separately reviewed large ship 01 and is not sufficiently distinct to justify another catalog entry.
limitations: Static glTF with 1K textures; three glTF validator warnings.

decisions.notes: Individually inspected all twelve views: colorful weathered plank hull, carved stern, three masts, furled and billowed sails, rigging, and fitted upper deck. Distinct from the other Dutch merchant ship.
limitations: Uses 1K texture maps, not the upstream 4K version.
Static shipped glTF contains no animation clips or armature even though upstream may offer a separately rigged format.
The furnished interior and enterability have not been verified.
Khronos validator reports seven warnings; see the packaged report.
